snippet.title: CHORDIOID - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
CHORDIOID on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893550/

it's finally real!!

CHORDIOID is a unique rhythm RPG that i've been working on for over three years. it's been a long road, full of dead ends and scope creep, but it's finally starting to resemble the killer RPG/rhythm game fusion i've dreamt of for so long.

with the help of some friends, i'm planning to release the demo, CHORDIOID: First Breath, later this year! after that, we'll be holding a Kickstarter to fund development of the full game. if successful, it'll be released in three chapters over the course of development.

CHORDIOID features a full original soundtrack, official modding support, hand-drawn cutscenes, in-depth accessibility options, and loads more!

thanks for reading, and i hope you're as excited for the future of this project as i am :)
  - ash

check out the CHORDIOID website: https://chordioid.com/
follow development on twitter: https://twitter.com/estroBiologist
